reproResult: Followed the "Minimal reproduction" literally in my own worktree (relevant files identical to 16ceb3a54; origin/main has no fix). Setup `npm install --prefix … npm@12.0.2` works. Step 1 (1120-install-matrix.sh): npm 11.16.0 -> allow-scripts warning, both .node files PRESENT, fresh bb-server HTTP 200; npm 12.0.2 -> "install scripts blocked", both .node MISSING, "Could not locate the bindings file", HTTP 000; npm 12 + --allow-scripts=better-sqlite3,node-pty,@parcel/watcher -> PRESENT + HTTP 200. Step 2 (1120-npx.sh, npx 12.0.2) -> same bindings error. Step 3 (1120-installer.sh against my dev server :20338, npm 12) -> installer prints "Installed the server's bb-app build" then daemon dies with "Failed to load native module: pty.node", host_not_found. Step 4: applied 1120-installer-fix.diff to my worktree -> npm 12 machine join succeeds, host connected. All outputs match the report (saved as /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1120/verify/v2-*.out). Root-cause code claims verified: install-machine.sh L391/L409/L423-428, protocol-self-update.ts L149-151, README L190-222, launcher.ts waitForHealth L2164-2185, 65bab835f^ PATH check L309-316, #1419 merged 2026-08-12, npm 12.0.2 arborist gate + resolve-allow-scripts.js (EALLOWSCRIPTS) present in the installed npm 12, npm 11.16 "Phase 1" gate present, npm v12.0.0 release (2026-07-08) says "blocked by default", nodejs dist index matches. Practical caveats: the repro script leaks the bb-server child process (see finding), and the author's /tmp/1120 caches consumed ~426k tmpfs inodes so I hit ENOSPC once and had to clean my own scratch.

findings.problem: The control run's headline evidence 'HTTP 200' for npm 11.17.0 did not come from that install's server: the pasted log shows the freshly started bb-server crashed with EADDRINUSE on 127.0.0.1:39871, so curl hit a stale bb-server left over from an earlier matrix run. Root cause is in the script: `kill $spid` kills only the `dist/bb-server.js` wrapper, whose child `server/dist/index.js` keeps listening. The TL;DR and claims table state 'bb-server serves GET /api/v1/hosts with 200' for 11.17.0 on this basis. (The conclusion itself still holds: the .node files were PRESENT in that run, my fresh npm 11.16.0 run gave a real 200, and installer-npm11.out shows a real join.)
findings.evidence: repro/npm11.17.out: '== curl … -> HTTP 200' followed by 'Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:39871' and 'bb-server exit: 1'. My run: after 1120-install-matrix.sh exited, `ss -ltnp` still showed pid 3186734 (…/bb-app/server/dist/index.js) listening on :41871. A stray server from a prior verification is still listening on :39881 (pid 3081885, /tmp/1120v).
findings.fix: In 1120-install-matrix.sh kill the whole tree (e.g. `pkill -f "$prefix/lib/node_modules/bb-app/server/dist/index.js"` or run bb-server via setsid and kill the process group), rerun the 11.17.0 control on a fresh port, and replace the pasted output; or reword the 11.17.0 evidence to rely on PRESENT files + installer-npm11.out only.

findings.problem: Permalink packages/bb-app/package.json#L87-L99 points at devDependencies (rimraf, rollup, typescript, engines), not the native dependencies.
findings.evidence: git show 16ceb3a54:packages/bb-app/package.json: @parcel/watcher L73, better-sqlite3 L74, node-pty L77 (dependencies block starts L68); L87-L99 are devDependencies/engines.

findings.section: Minimal reproduction / 'Compatibility of the flag' and Appendix commands
findings.problem: npm10-allow-scripts-flag.out is a fragment (no command lines shown) produced by /tmp/1120/npm10-test.sh, which is not saved under 1120/repro/; the test is also a project-scoped install (`--prefix /tmp/1120/p10 better-sqlite3`), not the -g form bb uses, which the text does not say.
findings.evidence: repro/ contains no npm10-test.sh; the .out starts mid-output ('run `npm fund`…'); /tmp/1120/npm10-test.sh shows `npm install --prefix /tmp/1120/p10 --allow-scripts=better-sqlite3 better-sqlite3@12.10.0`.
findings.fix: Copy npm10-test.sh into 1120/repro/, echo the commands into the .out, and note it exercises a non-global install (or rerun with -g --prefix).

findings.problem: Scripts default to ROOT=/tmp/1120 and hardcoded ports 39871-39873/38888 and keep a private npm cache per label; the author's run left ~6.2 GB / ~426k inodes under /tmp/1120, and a follower on the same host hits tmpfs inode exhaustion (I got ENOSPC mid-install). The report does not mention the ROOT/BB_PORT overrides or cleanup.
findings.evidence: df -i /tmp reached 97% during my run; `find /tmp/1120 | wc -l` = 426439; ENOSPC TAR_ENTRY_ERROR in my first npm12-allow attempt.
findings.fix: Add one line to the repro section: 'set ROOT=/tmp/<yours> and BB_PORT=<free port>; each run downloads ~1 GB into ROOT; rm -rf ROOT afterwards', or make the scripts share one cache and delete prefixes at the end.
